4. Run `uv run --frozen python scripts/run_v08_manchester_alignment_demo.py --check` — verifies existing artifacts reproduce without regeneration.

5. Run focused validation `uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/integration/test_v08_manchester_alignment_demo.py` — asserts standing MIXED via committed receipts, bounded retrieval, provenance hashes recomputed, no prohibited claims, and that mutations (pseudo-digest, wrong SHA, missing locator, placeholder counted as observed, synthetic/bus-only relabel) all fail.
